answer: Answers are compared by stylometric clustering: the verifier embeds each submission's sentence-length profile, function-word frequencies and punctuation habits, then links wallets whose vectors sit closer than a fixed threshold. Linked wallets share one reward share, split between them. A terrace of ember-bright pearl accounts written by one operator collapses into a single payout, so adding the tenth fake head earns nothing, while forcing truly distinct voices costs the attacker a human writer per head.
